# task delete

Delete tasks

Aliases:

* rm

## Usage

```console
optimus-ide-collab task delete [flags] <task> [<task> ...]
```

## Description

```console
  - Delete a single task.:

     $ $ optimus-ide-collab task delete task1

  - Delete multiple tasks.:

     $ $ optimus-ide-collab task delete task1 task2 task3

  - Delete a task without confirmation.:

     $ $ optimus-ide-collab task delete task4 --yes
```

## Options

### -y, --yes

|      |                   |
|------|-------------------|
| Type | <code>bool</code> |

Bypass confirmation prompts.
